# StockPilot local configuration (loaded by scripts/start_mac.sh and scripts/stop_mac.sh)
# Copy and adjust values as needed. Do not commit real API keys.

# Backend server bind address and port (SPEC: default 127.0.0.1:8010)
BACKEND_HOST=127.0.0.1
BACKEND_PORT=8010

# LLM access via OpenRouter. Leave the placeholder to run in mock mode.
OPENROUTER_API_KEY=your-openrouter-api-key-here
# true = deterministic mock LLM responses; false = live OpenRouter calls
LLM_MOCK=true

# Market data. Empty = built-in simulator is used.
MASSIVE_API_KEY=

0:finally/Dockerfile.content:
FROM node:20-alpine AS frontend-builder
WORKDIR /app/frontend
COPY frontend/package.json frontend/package-lock.json* ./
RUN npm install
COPY frontend/ ./
RUN npm run build
FROM python:3.12-slim
WORKDIR /app
RUN python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir fastapi==0.115.0 uvicorn==0.30.6
COPY backend/ ./backend/
COPY --from=frontend-builder /app/frontend/out ./frontend/out
EXPOSE 8010
CMD ["uvicorn", "backend.app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8010"]

[project]
name = "stockpilot-backend"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = [
"fastapi==0.115.6",
"uvicorn[standard]==0.34.0",
"sqlalchemy==2.0.36",
"pydantic==2.10.4",
"pydantic-settings==2.7.0",
"python-dotenv==1.0.1",
"sse-starlette==2.1.3",
"httpx==0.28.1",
"yfinance==0.2.51",
"pytest==8.3.4",
"pytest-asyncio==0.25.2",
]

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
include = ["app*"]
exclude = ["tests*", "scripts*", "db*"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
asyncio_mode = "auto"

# Test-harness ONLY — the application server runs on the HOST per SPEC.
# network_mode:host lets this container reach it at http://localhost:<port>.
services:
  playwright:
    image: playwright-go-test:latest
    user: "${DOCKER_UID:-1000}:${DOCKER_GID:-1000}"
    working_dir: /src
    network_mode: host
    environment:
      - CI=1
      - PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OPEN=never
    volumes:
      - .:/src
    command: >
      /bin/sh -c "npm install --ignore-scripts && npx playwright test"

0:finally/scripts/start_mac.sh.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

# Preserve any existing environment variables exported by the user in their shell
USER_OPENROUTER_KEY="${OPENROUTER_API_KEY:-}"
USER_LLM_MOCK="${LLM_MOCK:-}"
USER_MASSIVE_KEY="${MASSIVE_API_KEY:-}"

if [[ -f .env ]]; then
  set -a
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  source .env
  set +a
fi

# Restore user's exported variables if set
if [[ -n "$USER_OPENROUTER_KEY" ]]; then
  export OPENROUTER_API_KEY="$USER_OPENROUTER_KEY"
fi
if [[ -n "$USER_MASSIVE_KEY" ]]; then
  export MASSIVE_API_KEY="$USER_MASSIVE_KEY"
fi

# If a real OPENROUTER_API_KEY is present and user didn't explicitly force mock mode, default to live LLM
if [[ -n "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY:-}" && "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" != "your-openrouter-api-key-here" ]]; then
  if [[ -n "$USER_LLM_MOCK" ]]; then
    export LLM_MOCK="$USER_LLM_MOCK"
  else
    export LLM_MOCK=false
  fi
fi

# Ensure frontend static export is built if missing
if [[ ! -f "frontend/out/index.html" ]]; then
  echo "Building frontend static export (next build)..."
  (cd frontend && npm run build)
fi

# Prefer backend virtualenv python if available
PYTHON="python3"
if [[ -f "backend/.venv/bin/python3" ]]; then
  PYTHON="backend/.venv/bin/python3"
elif [[ -n "${VIRTUAL_ENV:-}" && -f "${VIRTUAL_ENV}/bin/python3" ]]; then
  PYTHON="${VIRTUAL_ENV}/bin/python3"
fi

exec "$PYTHON" -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app \
  --host "${BACKEND_HOST:-127.0.0.1}" \
  --port "${BACKEND_PORT:-8010}"

0:finally/scripts/stop_mac.sh.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT"

if [[ -f .env ]]; then
  set -a
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  source .env
  set +a
fi

PORT="${BACKEND_PORT:-8010}"
PIDS="$(lsof -ti "tcp:${PORT}" -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true)"

if [[ -n "$PIDS" ]]; then
  kill $PIDS
fi
